verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows conventional docs pages with prose and isolated code snippets (e.g. phaser-docs-35, phaser-docs-45) but no interactive API reference or in-browser runnable examples are documented; community feedback even criticizes the docs as outdated and hard to use (phaser-comm-3, phaser-comm-5, phaser-comm-17). No evidence of a live sandbox, embedded playground, or 'try it' API browser exists in the pack.
